title: My Leg!
blurb: Twenty-five years of Bikini Bottom catastrophes and somehow the same fish keeps getting hurt. Fred, voiced by Mr. Lawrence, is the show's longest-running background gag: any explosion, collapse or municipal disaster, no matter how tightly contained, will find his leg. The joke works through sheer commitment — nobody ever acknowledges it, nobody ever helps. Play it for collateral damage, minor injuries treated as full tragedies, and any group activity that claims exactly one innocent bystander. A genuine hall-of-fame running joke and a masterclass in comic persistence.
origin: Fred the Fish's recurring injury cry from SpongeBob SquarePants.
